selection.note: No route, workflow, platform, or layout is selected. Preference is recorded in assumption A13 and is not selection.

missing_value_policy: Null means undocumented, inaccessible, ambiguous, or conflicting. It does not mean zero, false, or absent. An explicit absence is a claim with value 'Not listed'.

dimensions.access_route: How Sentinel-2 products reach us: bucket, catalog, notification feed, or API.
dimensions.processing_workflow: How products become per-water-body records: locate, read, mask, flag, write.
dimensions.compute_platform: What runs the workflow: functions, containers, clusters, or provider compute.
dimensions.storage_layout: What holds the records: format, partitioning, indexing, revisions.

candidates.name: Earth Search STAC over the Sentinel-2 COG bucket on AWS Open Data
questions: Which collections exist and what level and baseline does each carry?
Which bucket and region hold the assets, and who pays?
How are new scenes announced?
Which quality layers are delivered as assets?
How far back does Level-2A coverage go, and are Collection 1 reprocessed products present?

candidates.name: Sentinel-2 L2A and L1C requester-pays buckets on AWS
questions: Which buckets, regions, and formats?
What does requester pays cost per request and per byte from the company's region?
Are notifications or inventories available for new scenes?
Are Level-1C quality masks and Level-2A probability layers included?

candidates.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem object store, catalogs, and processing APIs
questions: What are the object store endpoint, quotas, and egress terms?
Which catalogs exist and what do they expose?
Do the processing APIs export raw pixels for polygons?
How complete is the Collection 1 archive?

questions: Which collections, regions, and token requirements?

Which quality layers are delivered?

candidates.name: Google Earth Engine Sentinel-2 collections
questions: Can raw per-pixel values be exported for thousands of polygons, and at what quota and price?
Which cloud masks are available?
What are the commercial terms?

candidates.name: Sentinel Hub APIs
questions: Which API returns raw pixels for a polygon, and at what unit price?

candidates.name: NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2
questions: Is 30 m resolution compatible with assumption A7?

candidates.name: Mask once, windowed reads per scene
